text.tspan: 56 paid orders have no invoice. The three oldest, from September 2024, would get one:
One request, three documents, nothing sent yet. Shall I create them?
Done, three invoices exist now, for exactly the orders shown. 53 remain; each call takes up
to 50, and every invoice counts as one write against the budget, so a capped process stops.
No. 31 of 33 scheduled tasks are overdue, the oldest by 9 days 18 hours, and none has ever
run: the scheduler is not running on this host. Search index, thumbnails, mails and cache
invalidation wait with it. Start the messenger worker and scheduled-task:run, then check again.
One request: it attaches "invoice-sent" to #10028 and creates the tag on the way, since none
of that name exists yet. The order keeps its other tags. Say the word and I apply it.
